definitions.gloss: vegetarian diet; plant-based eating; eating vegetables
definitions.explanation: A diet centered on vegetables and plant-based foods, excluding or minimizing meat and fish.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{菜食|さいしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: She continues to follow a vegetarian diet.

notes:
Literally 'vegetable eating,' composed of {菜|さい} (vegetable) + {食|しょく} (eating/food). Refers to the practice or diet itself rather than the ideology — for the ideology, use {菜食|さいしょく}{主義|しゅぎ} (vegetarianism).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {菜食|さいしょく}{主義|しゅぎ} — vegetarianism
- {菜食|さいしょく}{主義者|しゅぎしゃ} — vegetarian (person)
- {菜食|さいしょく}⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧ — mainly vegetarian
- {菜食|さいしょく}⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧ — vegetarian cuisine
- ⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧{菜食|さいしょく} — strict vegetarian diet; vegan diet

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ベジタリアン→ベジタリアン：23298_bejitarian⟧ — vegetarian (loanword, more common in casual conversation)
- ビーガン — vegan (loanword)
- ⟦{精進料理|しょうじんりょうり}→精進料理：16101_shoujinryouri⟧ — Buddhist vegetarian cuisine (traditional Japanese term with religious connotations)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Traditional Japanese cuisine historically included little meat, and Buddhist ⟦{精進料理|しょうじんりょうり}→精進料理：16101_shoujinryouri⟧ has a long history. Modern {菜食|さいしょく}{主義|しゅぎ} as a lifestyle choice is growing but still relatively uncommon in Japan compared to Western countries.
